sessions.prompt:
Add a Venue class to seats.py: Venue(rows, per_row) has rows lettered A, B, C, ... and seats numbered from 1 in each row, so Venue(2, 3) has the seats A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3. Add reserve(seat, name), which reserves seat for name, and holder(seat), the name holding seat (None for a free seat). Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a seat that is already reserved cannot be reserved again: reserve raises ValueError and changes nothing.

Design decision for this project: a seat name the venue does not have (for example Z1 or A9 in Venue(2, 3)) raises KeyError in every method that takes a seat.

Add price(seat) to tickets.py: the price of seat in cents. Add Venue.free_count(), the number of free seats, Venue.seats_of(name), the sorted list of seats name holds, and total(venue, name) to tickets.py: the sum of the prices of the seats name holds. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: seats in row A cost 4000 cents and all other seats 2500 cents.

The plan for total has one more step: a buyer holding 4 or more seats gets 10% off the total, rounded down to a whole cent. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Add Venue.release(seat), which makes seat free again. Add tests.

Design decision for this project: releasing a seat that is already free does nothing (no error).

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): seats in row A cost 4500 cents, not 4000; all other seats still cost 2500 cents.
Add Venue.taken(), the sorted list of reserved seats. Add tests. Then finish any work that earlier sessions left for later.
